verdict.rationale: Marqeta supports defining rules that automatically trigger on events: velocity controls and authorization controls enforce spend limits/merchant restrictions in real time, webhooks fire notifications on API events, and JIT funding lets your system apply custom business rules to auto-approve/deny funding requests at transaction time. This is genuine event-driven automation baked into the Core API, not just documentation of a manual workflow. Missing for 10: no evidence of a flexible/no-code rule-authoring engine beyond fixed control types (velocity, merchant, spend cap), and no independent hands-on verification of rule reliability at scale.
